records.part: LiveScan fingerprinting system replacement for Juvenile Hall
records.reason: A waiver of competitive bidding requirements and sole source award for the purchase of a LiveScan fingerprinting systems from IDEMIA for a total of $30,600 pursuant to County Ordinance Code 2.36.090.

records.part: Current LiveScan fingerprint system to be disposed (Asset 101121, Tag 27899)
records.reason: The LiveScan system located in the Juvenile Hall was purchased in 2020 and has reached its shelf life and replacement is needed.
